_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Critical Safety Item (CSI)/Critical Application Item (CAI) List
summary: Details the system's Critical Safety Items and Critical Application Items and provides the relevant selection information for those items.
use_relationship:
The CSI/CAI List shall be used to detail the system CSI/CAI and to provide relevant selection information.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work (SOW).

This DID supersedes DI-SAFT-81932.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: Title of CDRL and CDRL number
Table of Contents
children.content: The document shall contain a table of contents providing the number, title, and page number of each titled paragraph, figure, table, and appendix.

children.title: CSI List
children.content: This section shall list in tabular form the Critical Safety Items of the system of interest. The table shall include part number, nomenclature, next higher assembly, next higher assembly nomenclature, next higher assembly part number, CSI or CAI designation, and if the part was classified on the basis of component cost or damage. If the component was classified on the basis of cost the list shall also include the component or associated damage cost value.
